papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.

papers.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Order-only on-policy distillation trains students to match teacher token rankings rather than probabilities, improving reasoning performance without temperature tuning.

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.summary: Layer-wise error modeling and token-wise Fisher statistics improve low-rank SVD compression of large language models by refining rank allocation and decomposition quality.

papers.title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
papers.summary: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization improves long-context retrieval in gated linear recurrent models by jointly configuring decay and sensitivity parameters before training.

papers.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: DR Pixel is an open-source multimodal agent that performs deep research directly on rendered document page images, improving retrieval and reasoning over scientific papers through counterfactual credit reweighting.
